title: Accept ADR 0071: optimisation of revision flowsheets
body: Lifts the old "optimisation unsupported" refusal and adds an `optimize` job: decisions and an objective are declared in a separate optimisation request (the flowsheet is never edited), Ipopt solves it, and the optimum is certified like a solve. It adds to the frozen application contract (ADR 0019 Amendment 16).
The questions below (Q1–Q9) carry defaults that are already built.
unblocks: OPT merges; RRC (continuation) merges after it.
